short.q: p = (2 over −3) and q = (−4 over 1). Find 3p + 2q as a column vector.
Find the magnitude of the vector (−8 over 15).
OA = a and OB = b. M is the midpoint of AB. Find AB and OM in terms of a and b.
short.model: AB = −a + b = b − a. OM = OA + ½AB = a + ½(b − a) = ½(a + b).

short.q: OP = 2a + b and OQ = 6a + 3b. Show that O, P and Q are collinear.
short.model: OQ = 3(2a + b) = 3OP. OQ is a multiple of OP and both start at O, so O, P and Q are collinear.

short.q: OABC is a parallelogram with OA = a and OC = c. P is on OB with OP : PB = 2 : 3. Find OP in terms of a and c.
short.model: OB = a + c. OP = 2/5 of OB = 2/5(a + c).
